"},{"spanIndex":15,"text":"For decreases in the job cost, an adjustment is made (from the initial fee on the initial Job Filing). "},{"spanIndex":16,"text":"Applicant can request a refund.
"},{"spanIndex":17,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":18,"text":"Post Approval Amendment (PAA) > The PAA Process – DOB NOW: Build Job Filings — When a PAA is filed, the following fields are NOT editable:
"},{"spanIndex":19,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":20,"text":"Post Approval Amendment (PAA) > The PAA Process – DOB NOW: Build Job Filings — When a PAA is filed, the following fields are NOT editable: — • Filing Review Type (e.g. "},{"spanIndex":21,"text":"Standard Plan Examination to Professional Certification) • Application/Location Address • Work on Floors (e.g. "},{"spanIndex":22,"text":"Location details) • Applicant of Record Information • Owner Information • Building Type
"},{"spanIndex":23,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":24,"text":"Post Approval Amendment (PAA) > The PAA Process – DOB NOW: Build Job Filings > Step 1: Log In to DOB NOW: Build — • Use the log in information that is registered in eFiling to log into DOB NOW: Build.
"},{"spanIndex":25,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":26,"text":"Post Approval Amendment (PAA) > The PAA Process – DOB NOW: Build Job Filings > Step 2: Locate Job Filing — • Locate the approved initial job filing on your dashboard in DOB NOW: Build . "},{"spanIndex":27,"text":"• Initiate the PAA. "},{"spanIndex":28,"text":"System generates filing number for the PAA. "},{"spanIndex":29,"text":"• Amend the necessary information.
"},{"spanIndex":30,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":31,"text":"Post Approval Amendment (PAA) > The PAA Process – DOB NOW: Build Job Filings > Step 3: Upload Required Documents — • Upload revised PDF of the plan sets. "},{"spanIndex":32,"text":"• Upload DPL1 document. "},{"spanIndex":33,"text":"• The system will determine if additional documents are required based on the information that is data entered on the PAA job filing.
"},{"spanIndex":34,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":35,"text":"Post Approval Amendment (PAA) > The PAA Process – DOB NOW: Build Job Filings > Step 4: Obtain Attestation — • Applicant, owners and other stakeholders must electronically sign the job filing.
"},{"spanIndex":36,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":37,"text":"Post Approval Amendment (PAA) > The PAA Process – DOB NOW: Build Job Filings > Step 5: Submit payment — • Payments will be made online using a credit card, debit card or e-check. "},{"spanIndex":38,"text":"• Anyone associated to a job filing can submit a payment.
"},{"spanIndex":39,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":40,"text":"Post Approval Amendment (PAA) > The PAA Process – DOB NOW: Build Job Filings > Step 6: Preview to File — • Applicant must review the filing and provide a final electronic signature.
"},{"spanIndex":41,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":42,"text":"Post Approval Amendment (PAA) > The PAA Process – DOB NOW: Build Job Filings > Step 7: Submit Job Filing — • Applicant must officially electronically submit the job filing to the Department.
"},{"spanIndex":43,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":44,"text":"Post Approval Amendment (PAA) > The PAA Process – DOB NOW: Build Job Filings > Step 8: Department Review and Approval — • Department staff will review the job filing. "},{"spanIndex":45,"text":"• If objections are issued, the applicant will be able to make corrections in the system and resubmit. "},{"spanIndex":46,"text":"• If a meeting is required to resolve objections, meetings will be conducted online. "},{"spanIndex":47,"text":"• The system will send email notification to all associated stakeholder listed on the job filing once the Department has approved the job filing.

"},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"How do I add or remove a floor from an application? — Work on floors can be changed with a PAA. "},{"spanIndex":2,"text":"The PW3 must also be updated to include the increase or decrease in the estimated work cost.
"},{"spanIndex":3,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":4,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Post Approval Amendments — How can I make a minor plan change to my approved job? — For minor plan changes for jobs after approval, submit a Post Approval Amendment (PAA) in DOB NOW. "},{"spanIndex":5,"text":"Upload a complete plan set with the new, unapproved sheets and the already approved sheets with the approved stamp. "},{"spanIndex":6,"text":"Include a description of the changes in the Comments field (Section 24) of the Plans/Work tab (PW1).
"},{"spanIndex":7,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":8,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Post Approval Amendments — For a PAA, if I am only revising one sheet, do I need to upload a complete set or just the one sheet? — For Professional Certification filings a complete plan set is always required. "},{"spanIndex":9,"text":"For Standard Plan Examination filings, a complete plan set needs to be uploaded if changes are being made to the approved plans. "},{"spanIndex":10,"text":"Submit the new unapproved sheets with no approved stamp and include the previously approved plans with a DOB stamp. "},{"spanIndex":11,"text":"The new unapproved sheets should indicate the P1 suffix on the filing extension, however, the approved plans with a DOB stamp should not be changed. "},{"spanIndex":12,"text":"Once the PAA is approved, the new plan set uploaded will replace the previous plan set for the filing. "},{"spanIndex":13,"text":"If no changes are being made to the plans, then a new plan set is not required with the PAA; select No to the question, Are you submitting updated plans?
"},{"spanIndex":14,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":15,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Post Approval Amendments — Is fee estimation for additional filing fees associated with PAAs done automatically in DOB NOW? — Yes. "},{"spanIndex":16,"text":"If the cost/scope of the job changes resulting in additional fees, the PAA will collect those automatically and payment must be made online before submitting the PAA.
"},{"spanIndex":17,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":18,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Post Approval Amendments — Can I change the owner on a PAA? — No. "},{"spanIndex":19,"text":"Owner changes are done through a supersede request. "},{"spanIndex":20,"text":"The new owner can log into DOB NOW: Build , Search by Job Number, and from the Filing Action select Supersede and then Owner. "},{"spanIndex":21,"text":"Select the Owner Type and then Save the request. "},{"spanIndex":22,"text":"If the owner type is not fee exempt, select the Pay Now button to pay the $130 fee. "},{"spanIndex":23,"text":"Then the Applicant of the job needs to log into DOB NOW and complete the Statements & Signature section. "},{"spanIndex":24,"text":"Then the new owner can also complete the Statements & Signature section and submit the request.
"},{"spanIndex":25,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":26,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Post Approval Amendments — Is owner’s signature required on a PAA? — Yes, in DOB NOW the questions on the Owner’s Attestation section can be changed with a PAA so the owner must provide a signature again in this section to submit the PAA.
"},{"spanIndex":27,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":28,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Post Approval Amendments — Where do I file a post approval amendment (PAA) on an existing BIS OT/GC, Alt-1 or NB job? — OT/GC filings in D status or later by December 23, 2020 and Alt-1 or NB jobs in D status or later by February 26, 2021 will continue to be processed in BIS. "},{"spanIndex":29,"text":"PAAs on existing BIS filings will continue to be filed in BIS.
"},{"spanIndex":30,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":31,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Post Approval Amendments — Do I need to upload an AI1 form with the plans to explain the changes in the PAA? — Do not upload an AI1 form with the plans when doing a PAA. "},{"spanIndex":32,"text":"Use the Comments field (Section 24) in the PAA filing to provide a description of the changes.
"},{"spanIndex":33,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":34,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Post Approval Amendments — Can I request a sign-off for a PAA? — No. "},{"spanIndex":35,"text":"PAAs are filed to update the information on an initial filing. "},{"spanIndex":36,"text":"The filing status of a PAA will always remain Approved."}]},{"passageIndex":2,"sourceID":"dob-application-guide","claimID":"official-passage-789cc7ccd439eb8374132031","contentHash":"9befc1cc76dd0efbfb76fed2960c262f1c4a61fc8dd786f9c30341251cc852b5","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"Page 5 of 38
"},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"JOB FILING /APPLICATION
"},{"spanIndex":2,"text":"A job is an application submitted for a construction project on a property, which can vary from making alterations to a single unit in an
"},{"spanIndex":3,"text":"existing building or to constructing a new building with many units. "},{"spanIndex":4,"text":"A job filing/application is submitted to obtain a Work Permit to
"},{"spanIndex":5,"text":"perform a specific type of construction.
"},{"spanIndex":6,"text":"All filings related to the same construction project should have the same job number and then an alphabetic and numeric extension that
"},{"spanIndex":7,"text":"indicates the filing type and sequence: I - Initial, S - Subsequent, and P - Post Approval Amendment (PAA).
"},{"spanIndex":8,"text":"• Initial Filings (I1) – The first or initial job filing created for a construction project .
"},{"spanIndex":9,"text":"• Subsequent (S) - A subsequent filing is an additional filing under the same job filing number that allows an applicant (the same one
"},{"spanIndex":10,"text":"on the initial or a new applicant) to add new scope of work and new work types to a job on the same property. "},{"spanIndex":11,"text":"A subsequent filing
"},{"spanIndex":12,"text":"can have a different review type (standard plan examination/professional certification) than the initial filing. "},{"spanIndex":13,"text":"Once submitt ed, a
"},{"spanIndex":14,"text":"subsequent filing functions as a separate appli cation. "},{"spanIndex":15,"text":"It can be permitted before the initial is permitted and a Letter of Completion
"},{"spanIndex":16,"text":"(LOC) is requested separately on each filing.
"},{"spanIndex":17,"text":"• Post Approval Amendment s (PAA) - A Post Approval Amendment or PAA is for making changes to a filing after it has been approved.
"},{"spanIndex":18,"text":"To create a job fi ling , log into DOB NOW: Build and from the dashboard select +Job Filing . "},{"spanIndex":19,"text":"Then select the Job Type , Work Type (s) , and
"},{"spanIndex":20,"text":"Filing Review Typ e .
"},{"spanIndex":21,"text":"Subsequent applications are strongly encouraged. "},{"spanIndex":22,"text":"All filings with the same job number will go to the same plan examiner or team and the
"},{"spanIndex":23,"text":"Records Management Fees are paid on the initial filin g only. "},{"spanIndex":24,"text":"It is also beneficial to have one job number to connect all of the work on a
"},{"spanIndex":25,"text":"project."}]},{"passageIndex":3,"sourceID":"dob-application-guide","claimID":"official-passage-99e3ff631d01ad61590ccecf","contentHash":"9befc1cc76dd0efbfb76fed2960c262f1c4a61fc8dd786f9c30341251cc852b5","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"Page 13 of 38
"},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"Filing Review Type
"},{"spanIndex":2,"text":"Standard Plan Examination or Review – submission of an application subject to t he Department’s standard examination process for plan
"},{"spanIndex":3,"text":"review and approval .
"},{"spanIndex":4,"text":"Professional Certification – s ubmission of application s, which are a ccepted with no Department examination , based on the professional
"},{"spanIndex":5,"text":"certification of an applicant who is a Registered Design Professional (RDP) stating that the filing is in compliance with all applicable laws.
"},{"spanIndex":6,"text":"Professional ly c ertified p lans are subject to an audit by the Department of Buildings.
"},{"spanIndex":7,"text":"The Job Type, Work Type and Filing Review Type cannot be changed once it is selected and submitted.
"},{"spanIndex":8,"text":"See the Filing Statuses Guide for a complete list of review statuses for both DOB NOW and BIS jobs. "},{"spanIndex":9,"text":"The status bar on a filing indicates
"},{"spanIndex":10,"text":"the pr ogress of the filing with a blue circle. "},{"spanIndex":11,"text":"A white check mark will appear in the circle once the stage has been completed by DO B and
"},{"spanIndex":12,"text":"the filing has moved on to the next step in the filing process. "},{"spanIndex":13,"text":"A red exclamation point will appear to indicate that the fili ng is waiting for
"},{"spanIndex":14,"text":"action by the applicant because DOB has issued Objections or the filing is in QA Failed status. "},{"spanIndex":15,"text":"Once the filing is complete, white check
"},{"spanIndex":16,"text":"marks will appear in all the circles on the status bar. "},{"spanIndex":17,"text":"If the filing is a PAA, an approval is indica ted by a solid blue circle without a check
"},{"spanIndex":18,"text":"mark."}]},{"passageIndex":4,"sourceID":"dob-application-guide","claimID":"official-passage-ce20f813e92241a7bc12804a","contentHash":"9befc1cc76dd0efbfb76fed2960c262f1c4a61fc8dd786f9c30341251cc852b5","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"Page 16 of 38
"},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"Stakeholders
"},{"spanIndex":2,"text":"All stakeholders require an eFiling account. "},{"spanIndex":3,"text":"Visit www.nyc.gov/efilin gtips for more information. "},{"spanIndex":4,"text":"All grayed - out fields will auto - populate with
"},{"spanIndex":5,"text":"information from the eFiling account.
"},{"spanIndex":6,"text":"Applicant and Owner: Enter the email address associated with the eFiling account of the Applicant and Owner . "},{"spanIndex":7,"text":"In most cases, the Applicant is a
"},{"spanIndex":8,"text":"Registered Architect or Professional Engineer. "},{"spanIndex":9,"text":"For the Applicant, also select the License Type and Business Name. "},{"spanIndex":10,"text":"For the owner, select the Owner
"},{"spanIndex":11,"text":"Type. "},{"spanIndex":12,"text":"If the Owner Type selected is Non - Profit Organization, NYC Agency, O ther Government Owned or NYCHA/HHC, then the fees will be removed
"},{"spanIndex":13,"text":"and an ACRIS report is required to verify the building is tax exempt.
"},{"spanIndex":14,"text":"Filing Representative and Delegated Associates : An email address can also be entered for Filing Representative Class I/ Preparer and Delegated
"},{"spanIndex":15,"text":"Associates (Filing Representative Class II or Other Licensee).
"},{"spanIndex":16,"text":"Filing Review Type, Work Type /Filing Includes
"},{"spanIndex":17,"text":"The Filing includes – select if the application is for New Work or Legalization . "},{"spanIndex":18,"text":"This option cannot be changed once the filing fees are paid.
"},{"spanIndex":19,"text":"If Legalization is selected and there is no OATH summons on the BIN for work without permit (WWP), then a $600 or $6000 fee, depending on the
"},{"spanIndex":20,"text":"building type, is added to the filing fees as a legalization fee. "},{"spanIndex":21,"text":"If legalization is selected and an OATH summons number for WWP is on the BIN,
"},{"spanIndex":22,"text":"select Yes to the question Are there any OATH/E CB summonses related to this work? "},{"spanIndex":23,"text":"and enter the DOB violation or OATH/ECB Summons
"},{"spanIndex":24,"text":"number(s). "},{"spanIndex":25,"text":"When a WWP violation is entered, there is no legalization fee and only a civil penalty for work without permit cal culated as an L2 fee.
"},{"spanIndex":26,"text":"An L2 is a request for ove rride, reduction or waiver of civil penalties for work without a permit violations. "},{"spanIndex":27,"text":"When the L2 request is created, the civil
"},{"spanIndex":28,"text":"penalty fee has to be paid before the permit is issued. "},{"spanIndex":29,"text":"Once legalization is selected on a filing, it results in a no work pe rmit and Post Approval
"},{"spanIndex":30,"text":"Amendments are not allowed. "},{"spanIndex":31,"text":"See 1 RCNY 102 - 04 (b) (7 ) for more information about legalization and civil penalties.
"},{"spanIndex":32,"text":"The work is being done to legalize work without a permit listed as a violating condition in a Request for Corrective Action ( RCA) issued by DOB?
"},{"spanIndex":33,"text":"– if Yes is selected, provide the complaint number of the RCA. "},{"spanIndex":34,"text":"See 1 RCNY 102 - 06 and the September 2021 Service Notice for information about the
"},{"spanIndex":35,"text":"Homeowner Relief Program.
"},{"spanIndex":36,"text":"Filing Review T ype - auto - populated based on the selection made when creating the application and cannot be changed.
"},{"spanIndex":37,"text":"The below selections are auto - populated based on the selection made when creating the application but can be changed in this section:
"},{"spanIndex":38,"text":"Is this Application for a Small Business?
"},{"spanIndex":39,"text":"Is this Application for an approved project under the M ajor Project Developments Program (MPP) ?"}]}]}}
